posterization.title: Posterization & Shape
posterization.colorsTooltip: The number of distinct color layers. 'Auto' detects prominent colors automatically.
posterization.backgroundThresholdTooltip: Pixels brighter than this value are treated as background and ignored.
posterization.shapeShrinkTooltip: Shrinks each color layer to create gaps and a more distinct layered effect.

kasaneOshi.title: Kasane-Oshi (Layered Stamp)
kasaneOshi.hint: Each color becomes its own stamp, collected one at a time at separate markers. Save the stamp, then use "Split into layers" below.

registration.title: Registration Errors
registration.shiftAmountTooltip: Average amount of horizontal/vertical misalignment between layers.

edge.title: Edge Effects
edge.widthTooltip: The thickness of the border area around shapes that can be boosted.
edge.boostTooltip: Increases ink density at the edges of shapes to simulate ink buildup.

wear.title: Wear & Tear
wear.inkDepletionAmountTooltip: How faded the 'worn out' patches appear.

splats.title: Ink Splats
splats.densityTooltip: Controls the number of ink splats used to draw the image.
splats.bleedingTooltip: Simulates ink bleeding into the paper just outside the stamp's edge.

display.title: Logbook Display
display.scaleTooltip: How big this stamp appears in the logbook relative to others. The app already normalizes for each stamp's actual ink coverage, so 1.0 is normal size — use this only to intentionally make a stamp more or less important.

realism.title: Realism
realism.pressureTooltip: Uneven hand pressure — one side of the print goes lighter along a random direction. 0 turns it off.
realism.paperGrainTooltip: Paper-fiber texture in the ink; fibers run in a random direction per print. 0 turns it off.
realism.inkMottleTooltip: Coarse unevenness in solid areas so they don't look digitally flat. 0 turns it off.
realism.dotGainTooltip: How much the ink soaks into the paper — lower values fatten midtones and soft edges. 1.0 turns it off.
realism.haloTooltip: Tiny ink specks squeezed just past the shape edges, like an over-inked stamp. 0 turns it off.
realism.inkColorJitterTooltip: Each print slightly shifts the ink's brightness and saturation, so no two prints use identical ink. 0 turns it off.
